metadata.description: State and territorial tax treatment of VA disability compensation and military retirement pay
metadata.disclaimer: Tax laws change frequently. Consult a tax professional and official state revenue sources.

va_disability_compensation.summary: Alabama does not tax VA disability compensation; state law mirrors federal treatment.
va_disability_compensation.notes: VA disability compensation is federally tax-exempt. Most states follow federal treatment.

military_retirement_pay.summary: Alabama exempts military retirement pay from state income tax for retirees age 55+ (phased implementation; verify current year thresholds).

property_tax_veteran_exemptions.summary: Alabama offers homestead exemptions for disabled veterans (100% rated) and surviving spouses; additional exemptions for veterans over 65. County assessors administer programs. ADVA coordinates certification.

va_disability_compensation.summary: Alaska has no state income tax; VA disability compensation is not taxed at the state level.
va_disability_compensation.notes: VA disability compensation is federally tax-exempt. Most states follow federal treatment.
